jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw
Interface HieroglyphsDrawer

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleHieroglyphicDrawer
public interface HieroglyphsDrawer

This class is responsible for everything which concerns the graphical appearance of hieroglyphs.

It doesn't deal with unkown or undefined codes. This file is free Software under the GNU LESSER GENERAL PUBLIC LICENCE. (c) Serge Rosmorduc

Author:
Serge Rosmorduc

Method Detail

draw

public void draw(java.awt.Graphics2D g,
                 java.lang.String code,
                 int angle,
                 MDCView currentView)
draws a hieroglyph, described by its code, on the drawing surface g. The view contains information about the scale, etc... TODO : add stuff about rotation ? or put it in the view ? Should be no-op if ! isKnown(code). IMPORTANT : also add stuff about reversal.

Parameters:
g - : where we are going to draw
code - the hieroglyph code in Manuel de Codage
currentView - : the view.

getShape

public java.awt.Shape getShape(java.lang.String code)
A try to test replacing bounding boxes by actual shapes. Should only be called if needed (rotations, complex sign placement). The shape needs not to be the real sign shape. It can be some sort of "bounding shape".

Parameters:
code - : the sign code.
Returns:
a bounding shape, or null if ! isKnown(code)
